title: Beiersdorf and Novelis push recycled aluminium in Nivea Creme tin to 95%
summary: The German skincare group is building on its partnership with aluminium specialist Novelis to raise the recycled aluminium content of its iconic Nivea Creme tin to 95%. This new achievement builds on an initial milestone reached in 2024, when the partners introduced a tin containing 80% recycled aluminium.
